title: Seen this before?
body: An open-source teacher that asks before it tells.
line: Keating is a teacher for the age of answering machines. It doesn't hand you the mountain. It teaches you to climb.

title: How should Keating teach you?
body: Pace, depth, where you get stuck — you set the terms.
line: It starts by asking how you learn: how much to ask before it tells, and what to do when you're stuck.

title: It remembers who you are
body: Languages, level, and goals shape every lesson.
line: It remembers who you are, the languages you speak, and what you're working toward.

title: Sources you can open
body: Every claim links back to where it came from.
line: When it looks something up, it shows its sources, so you can check the claim yourself.

title: Move the idea
body: Change one number and watch the curve answer.
line: Ideas become things you can move. Change a rate, and watch the curve answer back.

title: Learning leaves the screen
body: Go out, collect evidence, bring back what surprised you.
line: Learning leaves the screen: go out, gather evidence, and bring back what surprised you.

title: Say it before the clock runs out
body: Spoken practice, judged on what you actually said.
line: Recall is spoken and timed. Say it before the clock runs out.

title: Build it word by word
body: Sentences you assemble, not phrases you copy.
line: A new language gets built word by word, in an order you have to find.

title: A real exam, graded honestly
body: Question-by-question marks, with what to revisit.
line: And when you're ready, sit a real exam, graded question by question.

title: Wherever curiosity finds you
body: Browser, desktop, phone, terminal. Free and open.
line: Keating runs in your browser or on your own machine. The future should not make students smaller. Keating helps them grow.
